title: Native module-object endpoint for ambient exchange
statement: For every coefficient ring, projective-line scheme Y, and derived module M, nativeExchange is the ambient exchange component with the module-object pullback and pushforward endpoints exposed.

source.place: Second identity: fixed module-object endpoint normalization.

proof.text: Unfold the module-object pullback and pushforward definitions and use the ambient exchange component directly.

lean.statement:
def nativeExchange
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y))) :
    (moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M) ⟶
    (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (secondProjection Y)).obj
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (firstProjection Y)).obj M)
